t: customData/elements/Item/text

"It seems my word carries no weight!

What's a king supposed to do when no one listens to him?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I can't refuse my daughter!

I have indulged her every whim since she was but a babe. Everything she wanted was immediately handed to her!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Why are you standing there?

Or have you forgotten how a guest ought to be treated?

I'm hungry, and the road tired me out!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I see it's not the same now.

There used to be feasts that all of Sarnaut heard about!

Everyone knew this kingdom would greet you with sprightly songs and heady wine.

And no one ever doubted it."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Excellent! Well, since I'm a guest here now, let us celebrate!

If our princess is unhappy, we shall make her smile!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I would love to remember the old feasts of Irene, when tables were laden with food!

And I could use some music, enjoy a song or two!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"That time is past.

The time when humankind envied the elves' glory.

I would be grateful for anything you can spare."
customData/elements/Item/text

"After the long travels, I would like

To feast and drink, and of course,

To have a talk with the princess!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"That's right! I'd like to feast and dance myself!

Father wants us to suffer this bleak existence.

Will we live like this forever?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Eh, we can hardly expect a miracle!

My father is stingy when it comes to balls!

When my mother was alive, we had proper celebrations!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Let us celebrate!

Father, call for our troubadours,

Our dear guest deserves a proper feast!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Dear guest, I too long for merrymaking!

The kind of festivities where you meet all sorts of people!

What can be better than a grand ball?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"There is no end to my suffering!

Will a miracle happen? Will there be balls, hunts, and feasts?

Or will I die from sorrow and anguish?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Really, why don't we have balls and feasts anymore?

Father's whims plunged us into despair!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"How did you turn the kingdom into this?

Its greatness and power are nothing but ghosts of the past.

Well, we shall have to rectify this!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I see you are hungry for spectacles!

As strange as that sounds, I'll gladly help you!

Because I remember how it used to be."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Your wish is my command, Princess!

I'll tell you what it was like when people were full of joy!

And then perhaps we'll discuss other things!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'll be happy to fulfill the princess's wishes.

I will show you how to have fun, Daguta.

Let us invite your friends! Everyone you care about!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"It's unfortunate that everything has been forgotten!

Well, I'll just have to remind you!

First, we'll have a feast, and then we'll see."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Even though Irene is no longer what it was, I'll tell you everything, Princess.

About the time maidens wore colorful garments and troubadours sang of glorious feats."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Damnation! So I have finally met the one

who is worthy of my hand."
customData/elements/Item/text

"This is how you win someone's affections, Father!

This is a true hero worthy of my love!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, sweet stranger! Your speech is so compelling!

It's like honey, sweet to the soul! Who, if not him?

Oh, powers of this world, I'm losing my head at the sound of his voice!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I think I'm going to die!

From sadness, because so much time was wasted before I met him!

It's too bad we only met now!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I wish you had arrived sooner!

Perhaps all my search for a husband was in vain?

Because here he is!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Well, will no one ask me?

Am I not the king?!

So be it, let them have fun!

I don't believe Daguta. She'll get bored with this one like with all the others!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"You decided so quickly! Without me!

But personally I don't believe this will last!

She'll get bored with the dancing and this stranger!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"It's all very strange, truly!

But if that's what Daguta wants, let the stranger stay for a bit!

Let us celebrate!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Daguta, darling!

If that's what you want, we'll have celebrations!

I'd rather not, but I will do it to make you happy!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"It is a sad lot to be a father who is ignored by his own daughter!

Well, let them make merry, even though it pains me!

Let's see what comes of it!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"They don't care about me!

Oh, well.

If my daughter is happy, then so am I!

Let them make merry."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Daguta!

I'm angry with you!

Have you rejected your suitor again? You know the kingdom needs a ruler, don't you?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, damnation.

 Another suitor was turned away. And only a distant cry reminds us of him.

 How long will this go on?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Daguta, my dear daughter!

Something disturbed my sleep last night!

It was a cry of the suitor who was thrown off a cliff.

When will this end?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Daguta, my precious child!

I want you to find happiness!

As long as you are alone, your life will be sullied by despondency!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Poor child! No mother, no sisters!

Are you doomed to be alone forever?

Or will there be someone worthy of your hand?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Woe is us!

Daguta's lot is not an easy one. She lost her mother, and Irene is like a prison to us!

How can I help you, child?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I did not wish to see him again after the last night!

He snored loudly and tired easily!

It's time to find someone else!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Father! I've grown bored with my lover.

I want to get another, but there's no one to choose from!

There are enough handsome men around here, but..."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, Father!

I can't find the right one - what do I do?

I've looked everywhere! If only someone as perfect as the one in my dreams showed up!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Daughter, this is outrageous!

Get me a rod, and pull up her skirts. It's time to teach her a lesson!

Ah, there's someone at the gates. This will have to wait!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"If this goes on, we'll run out of subjects!

We already tossed the treasurer and the cook off the cliff. We don't have enough people left.

Right! Someone is here."
customData/elements/Item/text

"It is funny, indeed. You've turned this into a challenge, Daughter! Soon we're going to run out of people!

You've tried almost everyone!

But wait, someone has just arrived!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Ah, my dear daughter, my poor child...

I don't know how to help you! I have invited everyone who is close to the court! All in vain!

What's this? Someone's coming!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, woe is me!

It pains me that I can't help my daughter!

No amount of tears can help here!

Wait! I hear footsteps!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"The king that rules the kingdom he has no right to rule!

And with him, the princess who is notorious for her promiscuity!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"What's the problem? I don't get it...

Irene is beautiful, and so is the princess!

Nature was clearly generous, seeing how well-endowed she is!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Am I truly here? I don't believe it. It's been centuries!

And my Irene is as lovely as ever.

An exile's lot is a bitter one!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"My father is meddling again. A traveler has arrived, one we haven't seen before!

Will he let me speak with him?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, who is he?

Why is my heart beating so fast, like a bird trapped in a cage? What do I do? I don't know!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"It can't be!

What is this? Why am I so fond of him?

If he doesn't stay, I'll throw myself off a cliff!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"You interrupted us, sudden guest!

Well, we'll have to do it later. Tell us about yourself, but only the truth, because I shan't tolerate lies!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"You are lucky, Princess! We've been interrupted but don't think I'll forget.

Now, the guest. I'm curious how you found us."
customData/elements/Item/text

Who are you, traveler? What brings you here?

What do you want with my court? Are you here for Daguta's hand? Ha ha!
customData/elements/Item/text

"Daguta, the light of my life, we'll continue our conversation later!

And you, sudden guest, listen to the king. Or rather, tell us: where are you from and how did you get here?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Cursed fate! Oh, strange guest. You have found yourself in a kingdom that has its glory days behind it.

We are surrounded by the Astral now, cut off from the rest of the world.

Tell us, how did you manage to get here?"
customData/elements/Item/text

I welcome you, traveler!

What brings you to our kingdom? The world is fractured, and the paths that lead to us are not easy...

What brings you here? How did you get to our kingdom?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh! Trolls take you...!

If only I could tell you where I've been.

Would you recognize me?

But it's not time yet..."
customData/elements/Item/text

"I have many names, and I've traveled many paths.

If I tell you about them all, even eternity won't be enough. I came here because of Daguta..."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, the irony! Your question is a curious one, and it saddens me that you cannot appreciate the humor in it.

But trust me, it is funny... I've heard of Daguta's beauty, that's what this is about!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, this allod is so beautiful!

I've come from far away, and I'm going to leave it like that for now. I've heard a lot about Daguta's beauty!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm hearing mockery in this question. I've come home!

Even though the name that once inspired respect has long been forgotten.

But I wished to see Daguta, so that's why I'm here!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Well, the paths we far from easy, it's true.

I've been here and there, but there's nowhere I can call home. I'm an exile!

I came here to meet the one named Daguta..."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Ah, my father! He's and old grumpy man who needs to know everything!

Let's not anger our guest, let him keep his secrets."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Has your sight grown weak in your aging years?

Can't you see our guest is tired after his journey?

Leave your questions for later!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, joy! How splendid?!

A traveler showed up, perhaps he'll stay awhile!

I only hope Father will stop grumbling."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, dear guest! If you wish to keep your name and occupation secret, then so be it.

We won't trouble you, so make yourself at home!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm crying at the thought I might be rejected!

All because of my father and his questions!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh no, is he going to leave us soon?

I must stop it! I'll find a way to keep him here!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"What's going on here?

The princes is crying, the king is grim.

No, that won't do.

I want to see joy, not tears!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"And while Grallon would very much like to know everything, Daguta won't stand for it.

It's so easy to put the right thought into that lovely head!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Princess! You needn't worry. It's not my intention to leave Irene soon.

I'm tired, and there are matters that require our attention!

Let us begin festivities!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I wouldn't dream of upsetting Daguta, so I can assure you I intend to stay for a while!

Irene will become my home for the time being!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"The princess saves me from further questioning!

If it wasn't for her, I would've had to come up with something, because I couldn't tell them the truth!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, how beautiful you are, Princess. I hate to see you unhappy!

But rest assured, I'll be here for a while!"
customData/elements/Item/text
She quietly approached her father's bed and carefully took the Key of Creation off his neck.
customData/elements/Item/text

With the Key in her hands, Daguta hurried back to her beloved to give it to him...

What will he do? We'll learn in the next act!
customData/elements/Item/text
A lot has changed since a mysterious stranger came to Irene Allod. King Grallon's court has become a wonderful place...
customData/elements/Item/text
Frequent balls, hunts, and feasts – life was a never-ending celebration, all thanks to the stranger whose name remains a mystery.
customData/elements/Item/text
But Princess Daguta is getting more unhappy every day. She is falling deeply in love with the stranger, even though she does not know how to win his favor.
customData/elements/Item/text

"How dare you demand such a thing?

He is my father, and you want me to betray him?

But do I have a choice? If I give you the Key, this will bind us forever.

So be it!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"What do you want? The Key? Or is it me you want?

If it's me, how can you ask this of me?

But if there's no other choice, I'll have to do it!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Ha ha! Right, what can be easier than stealing something he guards preciously?

But if that's what you want, I'm willing to do it!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Father's Key?

The artifact he guards like the apple of his eye?

Well, I'll do everything for you, my love!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"If I give you Father's Key, I'll be cursed for eternity!

I'll be exiled!

But if that's what you want, so be it!"
customData/elements/Item/text

You want me to betray my father by stealing the Key?

To tear my heart apart and choose between you and him?

But I've decided – I'll do everything for you!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"How easy!

All I had to do was ask, and the princess was willing to do anything!

Well, I'll be waiting."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, sweet Daguta!

It's not your fault I've managed to fool everyone around here!

I needed the Key, and now it shall be mine!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Can I trust her? It won't be easy to get the Key from Grallon!

What if she fails. What then?

Oh, fates, why must I place my faith in a foolish girl?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, my father! And my beloved!

They are tearing me apart, I can't please everyone.

I have to choose, even though I hate it.

Damn it all, I'll do what I must!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Father would probably hand the Key over himself!

But it would take too long to persuade him!

So I'll have to do it while he's asleep.

That way, we'll skip the unnecessary conversation."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Honestly, the Key is just a trinket.

I'll take it, they'll sort it out later.

Yes, I'll just turn everything into a joke, then I won't get a scolding!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Father! Father!

What do I say? He won't just give me the Key. I'll have to take it quietly...

I just need to wait until he's asleep!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"What now? Everyone wants something from poor Daguta.

I'm tired of having to decide!

It's not my fault that I'm forced to do this!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"My heart feels heavy, because I have to betray my father!

To steal that Key and give it to my beloved!

It's awful, but so be it!
customData/elements/Item/text

Where have you been, daughter? I've missed you.

What did you talk about?

I hope there'll be no more tears!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"My daughter is back! How did your conversation go?

I hope your tears dried, and you are happy.

Let's get back to the festivities!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Can nothing make Daguta happy?

I see something troubles you again. What's ails my daughter?

I don't understand!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I want what's best for you!

I worry and I want you to find happiness.

Seeing you unhappy breaks my heart!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"When will you stop torturing me with your questions, Father?

As for how it went... That's none of your business!

Go to bed!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Ah, Father! I've seen many springs, but you still don't realize

That I'm not a child, so you don't need to fuss over me.

Go to bed now."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, Father. I'm glad, truly. Soon I'll have everything I have ever wanted.

Aren't you tired?

Then go to sleep, I'm sure it will help!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Yes, I'm really glad! There's always hope.

I see you're tired, Father.

Maybe you should rest. Go get some sleep."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, woe is me! Woe is me!

What did I agree to?

I'll tell you, but later.

Let's talk about it in the morning."
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm sad and worried, Father.

But hopefully everything will be fine.

Don't worry. Tomorrow will be a new day!"
customData/elements/Item/text

Oh, Daguta. I don't know what I'm going to do with you!

It's time for harsh measures!

I'll have you punished severely tomorrow.

But now I'm going to bed."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Daguta is an odd child, no one knows what will make her happy.

We tried everything, but all in vain. Should I convene the Council?

I'll decide in the morning."
customData/elements/Item/text

Push aside these heavy thoughts, Daughter. We're alive, so there's no reason to be upset.

Sleep will surely do me good.

I'm tired from all this business."
customData/elements/Item/text

Oh, my dear daughter! You are right as always.

I do feel somewhat drowsy. Perhaps I should take a nap.

We'll discuss everything else tomorrow, because tomorrow is a new day."
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm crying with you, my daughter. What's the matter?

Oh, cruel fate!

I'm tired and stressed. I'll go lie down for a bit..."
customData/elements/Item/text

I see nothing can make you happy.

Well, I'm tired of this all.

Hopefully sleep will help.

The sweet embrace of oblivion..."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, the Key my father guards!

I'm reaching out and taking it...

Let that treasure be cursed, since I'm forced to commit a crime!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"What separates me from a crime?

The motion of the hand that reaches for the Key.

But no one has the power to stop me.

Even my conscience is silent now..."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Ha ha! I'll take the Key!

Father is fast asleep, and nothing will disturb his dreams.

Luck is on my side!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, Father is asleep. What does he see? My mother, perhaps?

The time when Irene was one with the land that surrounds the kingdom?

I'm taking the Key now..."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Terror grips my heart when I think of what I'm willing to do to prove my feelings!

I'm holding the Key in my hand. It's done!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I feel so strange after betraying my father.

I'm taking the Key he's guarded for so long.

And it pains me that there's no other way!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"The princess is unhappy again! I'm sick of this!

What else does she want, the flighty girl?

I've done everything I could!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Nothing pleases Daguta anymore, what else can I do?

Capricious child!

Nothing is good enough for her, she dreams of something that doesn't exist!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"We've had feasts aplenty, everyone's joyous.

What else could you ask for?

I hope Daguta is happy as well."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Daguta seems unhappy again!

Poor child! Nothing pleases her, nothing brings joy!

I don't know what I can do to change that."
customData/elements/Item/text

"I've done everything I can for Daguta!

But it's all in vain, I failed to make her happy!

Damnation! When will she be happy?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm sick of these troubles of foolish girls.

But oh well! I'll have to help if the king wants me to."
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm not sure what I can do to please her.

Perhaps lashing will help. It usually does, they say.

I'll have to talk to her."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Make the princess happy? How?

Tickle her?

Or dance in front of her?

I'll give it a thought."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Dispel the princess's sadness? I'm ready.

I'll need to talk to her and find out what she wants.

Perhaps I'll think of something then."
customData/elements/Item/text

"I have to satisfy some capricious princess's whims now!

As though what I've done already isn't enough.

Well, I have no choice."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Soon I'll start crying over the princess's lot myself!

I have no idea what might amuse her.

I'll speak with her, and then perhaps..."
customData/elements/Item/text

"The nerve of him!

I'm the king here, and yet my word means nothing?

Let him solve this problem, then."
customData/elements/Item/text

"The stranger seems nice and polite,

And yet there's something suspicious about him!

We ought to keep an eye on that one!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"This vagabond is so odd!

He's clever enough, perhaps he'll come up with something that would amuse my daughter!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I hope he'll be patient with Daguta.

She's as delicate as a lily!

We mustn't let anything distress her."
customData/elements/Item/text

"When will Daguta be happy?

I fear I won't live to see the day!

I'll die before my time, having only known sorrow!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Who is he? It seems I won't know that.

Which is unfortunate, but at least my daughter will be pleased."
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm sick of these endless whims!

Tell me what I did wrong and what you really want!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I've met many young women, but none as capricious!

Tell me your secret - what do you do to make everyone so miserable?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Beautiful lady! Lovely Daguta!

I want to cheer you up!

Tell me, why are you sad?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, where are you, Daguta?

A lovely child of elven blood,

It's time we had a little chat."
customData/elements/Item/text

"It sounds like a simple task - to please a young elven girl!

But no, nothing in this world is simple!

It's easier to catch a dragon by the tail!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm looking for Daguta!

Tell me, what troubles your heart?

Why is your world so bleak? Tell me."
customData/elements/Item/text

"How rude! He's mocking me!

I've longed for your touch for days, but you rejected me!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"He shows up like nothing's wrong!

It's the second night I approach the bedrooms and he immediately disappears!
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'll happily laugh if you are with me, dear friend!

Tell me, how can I prove you are more important to me than the whole Irene and my father?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Sweet stranger!

I don't know what else would please you! What do you want from me?

How do I prove the sincerity of my feelings?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Everything around makes me unhappy!

I'm rejected by my beloved.

He doesn't care for me - he shuns my embrace, pushing me away!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I've missed you terribly!

But you are cold as ice! I can't figure you out!

Tell me, how can I be with you?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I sense treachery in you.

You've chosen people before, but once you grew bored with them, you discarded them.

How foul!

I wouldn't want to be one of them!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Words alone are of little worth.

Today you sing like a nightingale, but that's just a passing fancy.

I wish I could trust you, but how?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"But darling, you've done nothing to prove I'm dear to you.

And in these matters, you can't trust words alone."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Something weighs heavily on my heart.

Is this a jest?

What if everything turns out to be a game?

How can I trust you?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Yes, it saddens me as well.

You speak of love, but is there any truth to it? I can't see it.

I need more than words. I need actions!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Truly, what do you want me to do?

Jump off a high tower to prove some point?

What actions do you need?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Proof, you say. But what should I do?

If you demand it, and you don't believe me,

Then I shall do what you want me to do!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"So I need to prove something I've longed for?

But I'm no knight, I don't perform feats in honor of some fair maiden.

How do you intend to test me?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"What proof do you need?

How can I earn your trust?

I'm not sure what I can do here."
customData/elements/Item/text

"No one here trusts me - not you and not even my father!

Well, that's my lot!

I'll have to do whatever you ask of me!
customData/elements/Item/text

"It seems my lot is one of tears.

For I don't know how to prove it to you!

What should I do? I don't understand."
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm angry! My foolish daughter is willing to believe anything.

And this stranger? Can I trust him?

Who knows what he's plotting?
customData/elements/Item/text

"It is a peculiar situation: my daughter with her empty head.
And the stranger that no one knows anything about.

And yet, we put our trust in him.

The hand of fate is fickle."
customData/elements/Item/text

"It's strange. Perhaps it's wrong to allow

Some stranger to converse with Daguta.

I'd laugh at the joke myself.

The king's empty word!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"What are they talking about for so long?

I hope he succeeds where I did not.

Daguta, Daughter, just don't bring trouble on us!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"My heart is heavy.

Perhaps I was wrong to trust a stranger?

He has Daguta wrapped around his little finger, along with everyone else!

What do we do?"
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm worried about this.

My daughter and this stranger!

What does he really want? Why is he here?

I fear he may bring trouble on us."
customData/elements/Item/text

"I'm angry: I want to get back one thing.

The king, your father, has the Key of Creation. Bring it to me!

This is how you can prove you're on my side!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"Oh, proof of love! Well, that's easy.

Your father wears a powerful artifact around his neck.

Bring it to me, and that will prove everything."
customData/elements/Item/text

"Daguta, you precious flower!

I'd hate to force you. But...

Grallon's artifact, the Key. I want it.

If you get it for me, dove, then I'll believe everything you say!"
customData/elements/Item/text

"There's something I want more than anything else. It's the Key.
